title: Zesty Greek Fregola Salad
description: A peppery and energizing Greek salad featuring tender fregola, double-fried red pepper, and fresh eggs for a zesty, ovo-vegetarian bite.
instructions: Cook fregola in salted boiling water until al dente, then drain and rinse with cold water to stop cooking.
Heat 1/4 cup oil in a skillet over medium-high heat; fry sliced red bell pepper until crisp, then remove and let cool.
In a large bowl, combine romaine, cucumber, tomatoes, red onion, and cooled bell pepper.
Add the drained fregola to the vegetable mixture and toss gently.
Whisk together lemon juice, 2 tbsp olive oil, oregano, and red pepper flakes; pour over the salad and toss again.
Arrange sliced hard-boiled eggs on top of the salad.
Sprinkle crumbled feta evenly over the eggs.
Drizzle remaining olive oil over the entire dish.
If desired, garnish with fresh oregano leaves.
Serve immediately at room temperature or slightly chilled.
